**Chinese name:** 上海兆芯集成电路股份有限公司 (Zhàoxīn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The state-backed (Shanghai United Investment 50.07%) second x86 path — the only domestic vendor natively running standard Windows+Linux binaries on desktops; July 2026 reporting put ZX86 laptops at ~50% of central-government procurement. STAR IPO accepted June 2025 (¥41.69亿 raise); inquiry responses (April 2026) show FY2025 revenue ≈¥11.11亿 (+54.8%) against ≈-¥10.3亿 loss — still the classic loss-making CPU startup awaiting a listing test.
:::

## What does this firm design?

x86-compatible desktop/server/embedded CPUs, chipsets, instruction-set extensions; GPU affiliate.

| | |

| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | x86-compatible CPUs: 开先 KX desktop/embedded (KX-7000, 8-core/3.7GHz, chiplet), 开胜 KH servers (KH-50000 up to 192 cores dual-socket) |
| **Node Sophistication** | KX-6000 16nm; KX-7000/KH-50000 on more advanced undisclosed node (~N7-class presumed — not verified); domestic-fab pivot underway |
| **Entity List** | No |
